msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia little-things-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of a statement necklace of twisted blue rope with a long rust-orange fringe and a brown pompom, with round matching earrings from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia little-things-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a statement necklace of twisted blue rope with a long rust-orange fringe and a small brown pompom from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia little-things-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a chunky bracelet with a large gold ring clasp and charms: a yellow star, a red drop and green beads from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia little-things-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a burgundy rope necklace with a big baroque pearl and a gold stirrup pendant from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia little-things-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a black cord phone strap with colourful resin beads in orange, white and burgundy from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
